message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block codeRepo:collection, fileServer:lateralMovement, and memoryDump:credentialAccess. Blocking memoryDump disables apiToken and dbLogin, which disables backupHost, serviceAccount, hypervisor, localAdmin, and secretsManager. Together with blocking fileServer and codeRepo, this makes all four target parents unreachable. Three blocks are necessary because three attack derivations have disjoint blockable steps: (1) sshKey → fileServer → shareMount; (2) ciRunner → browserStore → monitoringHost → codeRepo; (3) memoryDump and dmzWeb → apiToken → backupHost → dbReplica. Each derivation is supported by always-reachable entry footholds, so at least one step in each must be blocked."}
